title: The attribution pipeline, seven stages
desc: Left to right: OAuth and token watch; ingest to our own copy; LLM extraction (dashed, the model); validate at the boundary (highlighted); dedup to canonical; confidence score; the report. Failures drop to a reject log.

label: OAuth +
token watch
nodes.say: OAuth into the CRM, store the tokens, refresh them before they expire.

label: Ingest to
our own copy
nodes.say: Pull deals and engagements into our own tables; their CRM stays the source of truth for their data.

label: LLM
extraction
nodes.say: The model reads each deal and returns plausible data: sometimes right, sometimes invented.

label: Validate at
the boundary
nodes.say: Every response is schema-validated. What does not parse is rejected and recorded.

label: Dedup to
canonical
nodes.say: Ten names for one asset collapse onto one canonical record.

label: Confidence
score
nodes.say: Every link carries a confidence score instead of pretending to be certain.

label: The
report
nodes.say: The report shows high-confidence matches by default; the grey zone stays reviewable.

groups.label: Downstream: where the trust comes from

notes.text: The LLM is one stage out of seven.
